reasonUnassigned.context: Savings > Borrow from savings: why a source of money is suggested, shown under the account's name. The money on that account isn't set aside for a goal yet. Lowercase, a fragment.

reasonDue.context: Savings > Borrow from savings: shown under a goal suggested as a source. {month} is the goal's target month and year, e.g. 'March 2027'. Lowercase fragment.

reasonNoDeadline.context: Savings > Borrow from savings: shown under a goal suggested as a source that has no target date. Lowercase fragment.

sharesTooHigh.message: To odkłada {total}, a na koncie jest tylko {balance}. Zmniejsz udział któregoś celu.
sharesTooHigh.context: Savings > account > correcting how much of the account belongs to each goal: error when the shares add up to more than the account holds. {total} and {balance} are amounts with currency.
